This '''BD-3000 luxury droid''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Following the attempted assassination of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during her political mission to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] devised a trap to catch the assassin [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] by having this [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|BD-3000 luxury droid]], wreathed in a robe, take Padmé's place at the conference while Padmé castes her speech through the droid via telecommunication from her quarters.
